The '''Volcanic Mine''' is a large volcanic chamber found underneath the [[Fossil Island Volcano]]. The mine entrance is located in the north-east corner of the volcano, with [[Petrified Pete]] guarding its entrance. Players can participate in the eponymous [[minigame]] inside the mine.

To enter the mine, players must have level 50 [[Mining]]. In addition, players must pay Petrified Pete 30 [[numulite]] each time to enter the mine. A one-time fee of 3,000 numulite can also be paid for permanent access.
